eval: (() => { if (!window.__origFetch) window.__origFetch = window.fetch.bind(window); const of = window.__origFetch; window.__picks = []; window.__dialogs = []; window.__last = {}; window.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input.url; let cmd = null; try { const u = new URL(url); if (u.hostname === 'ipc.localhost' || u.protocol === 'ipc:') cmd = decodeURIComponent(u.pathname.slice(1)); } catch {} if (cmd === 'plugin:dialog|open' || cmd === 'plugin:dialog|save') { window.__dialogs.push(cmd); const v = window.__picks.length ? window.__picks.shift() : null; return new Response(JSON.stringify(v), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Tauri-Response': 'ok' } }); } const res = await of(input, init); if (cmd) { try { window.__last[cmd] = await res.clone().json(); } catch { window.__last[cmd] = '(non JSON)'; } } return res; }; return 'dialogues natifs court-circuités (IPC)'; })()
